justification: Inspected byte-buddy-benchmark/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/benchmark/ClassByExtensionBenchmark.java:594-608 and byte-buddy-benchmark/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/benchmark/ClassByExtensionBenchmarkByteBuddyInterceptorTest.java:10-34.
